string-array.name: rd_whats_new_items
string-array.item: Adding a subtitle from a link no longer closes the app on Android 5 and 6.
Live TV takes only the stream settings a playlist really needs, so a playlist can\'t make the app write files.
Check for updates only ever opens this project\'s release page.
A subtitle link that fails says why in your language.
On older Android, the TV welcome screen and the library\'s headings look as designed.
